Cis-pQTL Mendelian Randomization and Colocalization Results

Source: R/data.R
pqtl_mr_coloc.Rd

Summary statistics from a two-sample cis-pQTL Mendelian Randomization (MR) and Bayesian colocalization (coloc.abf) study linking UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKB-PPP) plasma protein levels to 17 FinnGen R12 clinical disease endpoints across cardiovascular, allergic skin, and autoimmune/metabolic categories (Terekhova et al., Immunity 2026).

Usage

pqtl_mr_coloc

Format

A data frame with 323 rows and 15 variables:

symbol

Gene/protein symbol (e.g. "IL7R", "CD27", "GZMB", "LTB").

set

Biological functional class of exposure protein ("GZMB_effector", "early_memory", or "lineage").

phenocode

FinnGen R12 endpoint identifier code.

label

Full descriptive disease endpoint label.

label_short

Shortened disease endpoint label for publication figures.

family

Disease family category ("cardiovascular", "skin_atopy", or "immune_metabolic").

family_label

Formatted factor for disease family facets.

set_label

Formatted factor for exposure protein class facets.

b_mr

Causal effect estimate (Wald ratio \(\beta\)) per SD genetically higher plasma protein.

se_mr

Second-order delta-method standard error of the Wald ratio.

z

\(Z\)-statistic (\(b_{\text{MR}} / \text{SE}_{\text{MR}}\)).

p_mr

Association p-value of the Wald ratio.

or_per_sd

Odds ratio per SD genetically higher plasma protein.

PP_H3

Posterior probability of colocalization hypothesis 3 (two distinct causal variants in locus / LD artifact).

PP_H4

Posterior probability of colocalization hypothesis 4 (one shared causal variant).

q_mr

FDR-adjusted q-value across the 323 tested pairs.

lead_is_top_cis

Logical. Whether the instrument variant is the primary cis-pQTL lead in UKB-PPP.

Source

UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKB-PPP) discovery plasma pQTL summary statistics and FinnGen Release 12 GWAS summary statistics.

References

Terekhova et al. (2026). Pan-atlas of immune aging reveals single-cell trajectories and plasma biomarker signatures. Immunity.

Examples

data(pqtl_mr_coloc)
head(pqtl_mr_coloc)
